■ Direction Note
Pause: Approx. 2 seconds of silence

Daaaaaaaahhhhhh—!!
Haaaaaaaahhhhhh—!!

Rudolf told me before, you know.
That a trainer possesses things that could never come from myself.

Everything, huh...
...Ah, right. What you wanted was the Classic Triple Crown, wasn't it?

Mr. C.B.'s body sank deeply.
Digging in hard, lowering her center of gravity, and before I could even catch my breath—

(...If only my head were a bit more flexible,
would I have decided to make him my trainer right away?)

...It seemed she remembered what I had said during my very first scout.
Even so, mentioning the "Triple Crown" back then was merely one example.
(Right now, right here, just, only...!)

When she told me that, it didn't really click, but...
hearing about your dream—the dream you see in me—made me understand.

...That's incredible.
You really say some amazing things, don't you?

...? What is the matter, C.B.?
Is that... the trainer who has been so earnest with you?

I wouldn't scout someone like that to begin with—hm?
......

Symboli Rudolf accelerates once more.
The gap between her and Mr. C.B. widens again.
...If I run, does that let you dream?

—I hurriedly chased after her and pulled the contract out of my bag.
And so, the days of dreaming alongside her had begun.
(If only I were an Umamusume who could run for the sake of something...)

Still, I didn't want my Trainer to feel holding back, y'know?
If I'm gonna sign a contract, I want our interests to align.
Mr. C.B. squinted her eyes with a smile.

(I don't need anything more than this... There is no greater value...!
This is it. This is truly—!)

No way. It's just... I got curious about what it'd feel like,
that's all.

...Hey, Rudolf.
Why is it that you can run for someone else's sake?

(...If only my mind were a bit more flexible,
maybe I would've immediately thought to make her my Trainer.)

......If you say you'll simply dream for me,
then I feel like everything just clicks into place.
Huh? No way, did your legs give out?
With that, Mr. C.B. blinked a few times.

Even now, I still think I can't do it,
and I'm sure it'll stay that way in the future, too.
She breaks into a run, as if leaving everything behind.

Being forced to, or being expected to...
Running a race for someone else, or for some specific purpose—I just can't do it.

It's not about so-called "track records" or "results." You possess a more primal
brilliance that can guide a person's life. When I told her that—

...
See, I'm really not good with being tied down.

That's why I could never decide on a Trainer, no matter how much time passed.
But—

From the imaginable to what people call impossible,
Mr. C.B. can surpass every single dream.

Neither you nor I have to hold back. And what's more, it feels amazing.
It's a mysterious tailwind that could never come from within me alone.
(It's fun, it's fun, it's fun, I can't get enough of this fun!)
You just dream for me, and I'll run however I like.
Just as I thought that—
Not glory... but dreams?

I conveyed that I simply wanted to express the boundless potential
I felt within Mr. C.B.
Yeah. When I had that cold, you really took great care of me.

If you're okay with that too, get the contract ready.
I'll be counting on you from now on.

For you to ask a question like that...
Did you suddenly feel like running for someone else's sake?

A few days later... In the distance,
I caught sight of her heading toward the gates alongside Symboli Rudolf.
Come to think of it, that's exactly what I thought the very first time I saw her.

Hey~! What's wrong, are you okay?
Don't tell me... did you catch my cold...?

It's not about so-called "track records" or "results." You possess a more primal
brilliance that can guide a person's life. When I told her that—
(—Ah, but right now... none of that even matters!)

—Before I knew it, I had slumped to the ground.
I had no idea which of them won; all that remained was pure, soaring exhilaration.

—Soon enough, the race began.
I rushed into the stands and clung tightly to the fence.
Ha, ha, haa...!
And so, as if intertwined, the two of them dashed across the finish line.
Taaaahhhhhh!!

Symboli Rudolf takes up the front position, gradually widening the gap
bit by bit. Before long, they reach the third corner.

Mmm~! It really feels nice here after all.
...It might've been a while since I came here with someone.

And then, that evening.
Mr. C.B. invited me out for a walk.
Before I could give my answer, she gave a light wave and walked away.
Troubled days or not, I won't be holding back on you.
Heh, heheh, ahahaha...!
